snippet.title: Hand of Hexes Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Hand of Hexes is an upcoming tower defense deckbuilder game without any text. Play cards to place towers and cast spells, but be careful: towers do not just aim at your enemies, but fire with unique attack patterns, so strategic placement and building a varied deck is even more important to make the most of them. For instance, a penguin might only shoot straight down while freezing enemies, whereas the hive tower sends a swarm of bees to all tiles surrounding it. The game features cardboard cutout graphic and lots of magic paper kittens. 
Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238220/Hand_of_Hexes/
